svg.title: Anhedral default application stack
svg.desc: Next.js App Router web through Cloudflare OpenNext and Expo iOS/Android connect to a Hono API on Cloudflare Workers. Drizzle with D1 and private R2 are included. Better Auth, shared design tokens, separate web/native UI and workspace tools support the foundation. Stripe and RevenueCat provide optional payments, with entitlements enforced by Hono. Dotted branches show extension points for additional clients such as desktop, browser extensions and AR/XR, and integrations such as AI and realtime.
